remarks: A rare opportunity to own a newly built 2027 residence just mins from Greenwich's finest shops, restaurants + schools. Set on .72 acres, 3 finished levels connected by elevator offer exceptional craftsmanship throughout. Main level features formal living + dining rooms, private office, family room w fireplace and a chef's kitchen w walk-in butlers pantry. The family room opens to a covered terrace w FP, Phantom screens + heaters -- ideal for year-round entertaining. Upstairs, primary suite features a FP, private deck + spa bath w wet room, accompanied by 3 additional en-suite bedrooms with walk-in closets. Finished lower level offers a gym, sauna, cold plunge, kitchenette, pool bath, guest suite + exterior access. A private yard + pool complete this exceptional in-town offering. NSS + CMS.
